title: Only The Owner Hears
description: A dozen customers could have shipments in flight at once — booking one of them shouldn't ring a bell in anyone else's inbox.
successCondition: As customer A, book a shipment. As a different customer B (with existing notifications of their own from prior activity, or none at all), wait past the queue delay and confirm GET /api/notifications as B does NOT include a "Shipment booked" entry for A's shipment. Querying the notifications table via `npm run db:psql` confirms the new row's user_id equals A's user id exactly, and no new row with user_id equal to B's id was created by A's booking.
hints: notify() is always called with the specific userId of the shipment's own customer (apps/api/src/modules/booking/service.ts) — there's no broadcast-to-all-customers code path anywhere in this event.
Register two separate throwaway customer accounts so you have full control over which one's inbox you're checking.
